originalTitle: Before 2030, Toyota will be selling cars with solid-state batteries with a >=1000km range chargeable in under 15 minutes
title: Toyota 固态电池汽车能否同时达到续航与充电目标？
Will Toyota’s solid-state cars meet both range and charging targets?
rules: 原题要求 2030 年前销售、续航至少 1000 km、充电少于 15 分钟，并采用固态电池。
The question combines sales before 2030, at least 1,000 km range, charging under 15 minutes and solid-state batteries.
interpretation: 四个条件需要同时核对。原题未充分给出续航测试工况和充电区间，不把宣传中的不同测试数字拼成一次验证。
All conditions require review. Range test cycles and charging intervals are underspecified; separate promotional measurements must not be combined.

summary: 原题把 2030 年前销售、至少 1000 km、少于 15 分钟充电和固态电池放在同一条件里；平台停盘字段早于题目期限。
The question combines pre-2030 sales, ≥1,000 km, <15-minute charging and solid-state chemistry; the API close field is earlier than the textual deadline.
checklist: 同一款量产车同时满足原题的所有条件。
Verify all conditions for the same production vehicle.
核对续航测试工况及充电起止 SOC、温度与功率。
Check range cycle and charge SOC, temperature and power.
停盘字段与题目期限不一致，不能将其中一个直接当成另一个。

stage: 材料供应 → 耐久性 → 车型认证与销售
impact: 出光合作触及硫化物材料供应和大型中试，能说明供应链如何为整车开发做准备。路线图提供性能目标，但只有同一款销售车辆的规格和实测工况，才能同时对应本题的三项要求。
Idemitsu cooperation addresses sulfide supply and pilots. A roadmap explains targets; evidence for one sold model is needed to connect the contract’s combined performance requirements.
gap: 未据这些公告确认已经销售符合全部条件的车型。另有停盘字段与文本期限的差异，不能把商业计划或市场元数据误写成完成日期。
These announcements do not establish a qualifying vehicle sale. The API-close/text mismatch remains distinct from any corporate target.

title: 整车续航与快充，不能只看电芯的一项数字
Vehicle range and charging are system-level conditions
principle: 续航与可用电量、车辆能耗共同相关；快充时间还取决于起止荷电状态、温度及充电功率。固体电解质路线的突破并不自动给出某一辆量产车的续航，也不能把 10–80% 充电时间读成 0–100%。

Range depends on usable energy and vehicle consumption. Charge duration also depends on starting/ending state of charge, temperature and power. An electrolyte advance does not establish a production vehicle’s range, and a 10–80% charge is not a 0–100% charge.
example: Toyota 的公开路线区分多类液态与固态电池；出光合作聚焦硫化物电解质。判断这个同时含有续航、时间与销售条件的市场，必须让证据落到同一款实际车型，而非从不同项目中各挑一个数字。

Toyota’s roadmap separates liquid and solid electrolytes, while its Idemitsu collaboration focuses on sulfides. Evidence for this combined range/time/sales question must identify the same actual vehicle rather than combine figures from different projects.

label: 停盘与题目期限不同
API close differs from textual deadline
detail: API closeTime 位于 2027 年初，原题说 2030 年前。页面保留两者，不据此替原题改写期限。
The API closeTime is in early 2027; the question says before 2030. Both are retained without silently rewriting the contract.

label: 参与较少
Few participants
detail: 概率来自少量参与者；查看成交数量与原始规则。
Few participants contribute; review activity and source rules.
